tools.name: bar_model_capabilities
tools.description: Read supported bar-model content, versions, limits, presentation and revision operations before creating a resource.

tools.name: create_bar_model
tools.description: For the improved layout explicitly supply spec:{schemaVersion:2,starter:part-whole|comparison|equal-sections|inline-ratio,count?,ratio?:positive-integer-array,partitioned?,comparisonLengths?:[longer,shorter],bars?,annotations?,captions?,title?,presentation?}. See capabilities.v2.specSchema for complete strict nested fields. V2 parts have labels:{inside,above?,below?} and fill:none|neutral|blue|green|amber; each label is {text,state}. annotations:[{id,scope:{kind:whole,barId}|{kind:range,from,to},label,decoration:none|brace|dimension,placement:above|below|inside|between}]. Whole scope follows a bar; fixed endpoints stay fixed. Captions:{id,label,alignment:left|centre|right},max3; title is a label. Output grey/colour is saved. Bare requests and legacy specs remain v1; never mix v1 fields with schemaVersion:2. Create editable Bar modelling resources. Supply spec OR exact envelope, never both. spec:{example?:BM01..BM09|H07|H18|source-sharing,worked?:false,bars?,spans?,presentation?}; example and custom bars/spans are mutually exclusive. Omit for BM01 unworked sharing64 in3:5. bars:[{id,name:{text,state},offset:numeric-string,parts:[{id,weight:positive-numeric-string,label:{text,state},shade:boolean}]}]. spans:[{id,from:{barId,partId,edge:start|end},to:{barId,partId,edge},label:{text,state},side:above|below,style:brace|dimension}]. Labels state:value|blank|question|line|hidden; hidden retains text. Shared presentation:{unitMm:4..16,barHeightMm:8..16,fontPt:10..14,nameWidthMm:20..60}. Up to6bars,24parts/bar,96parts,18spans,32KiB. Exact geometry fractions/decimals,algebra labels never evaluated. Whole/share/difference braces anchor actual boundaries. No automatic calculation. Returns canonical envelope/hash,preview,SVG,600ppiPNG,JSON,versions,native size,print facts,bounded editor link and warnings. Editable files/links retain hidden answers; pupil output default.

tools.name: revise_bar_model
tools.description: V2 operations add upgrade_document{} (exactly once FIRST on v1); set_section_label{barId,partId,slot:inside|above|below,label}; set_section_labels{barId,partIds,slot,label}; move_or_copy_label{from:{barId,partId,slot},to:{barId,partId,slot},mode:move|copy,overwrite?:false}; set_annotation{annotation}; remove_annotation{annotationId}; equal_sections{barId,count,discardContent?:false} preserves exact total; changed count replaces IDs and needs explicit discard for affected labels/fills/fixed anchors. set_fill{barId,partIds,fill}; add_caption/update_caption{caption}; remove_caption{captionId}; set_title{label:null|Label}; set_presentation{presentation,autoName?}; set_quantity_name{barId,label}; set_relative_length{barId,partId,weight}; append_section{barId,part,afterId?}; append_bar{bar,afterId?}; reorder_bars{barIds}. Refer to the complete emitted operation schema. Without explicit upgrade, legacy sources stay v1 and reject new features. A later failure rolls back the entire batch including upgrade. Retained hidden destinations require explicit overwrite. Between annotations must still attach to adjacent bars. Revise exact bar-model envelope with baseHash=contentHash and operations(max30,atomic). set_label {target:{barId,partId?}|{spanId},label:{text,state}}; set_part {barId,partId,weight?,shade?}; add_bar {bar,afterId?}; remove_bar {barId,discardSpans?:false}; add_part {barId,part,afterId?}; remove_part {barId,partId,discardSpans?:false}; add_span {span}; set_span {span} replaces exact identified span; remove_span {spanId}; set_alignment {barId,offset}; set_print {presentation:{unitMm?,barHeightMm?,fontPt?,nameWidthMm?}}; reveal_saved_answers {} only on explicit request. Use complete bar/part/span schemas from create_bar_model and stable returned IDs. Removal of referenced parts/bars requires discardSpans:true or prior explicit span removal; never reanchors. Label state changes preserve supplied saved text. No implicit maths, answer reveal or resizing from labels. Empty operations refresh files/links. Returns envelope/hash,preview,SVG,verified600ppiPNG,JSON,native dimensions,versions,print facts and warnings; editable files/links retain hidden answers.
